searchText: Probably, either add headers, or convert to unordered lists. Tables don't really make sense if there's no identifier for the columns, might as well be a list with colons. My concern with that is that it binds the EIPs site to being rendered in places/ways that can render both MD and HTML. Right now you can render EIPs anywhere that you can render MD, which includes text editors to some extent since MD is easily human readable as plain text while HTML is not. Not a horrible solution. I do like the table formatting a bit better, but maybe it isn't worth it. Whining aside, I don't think it's important enough to not let the author do what they want. I understand. It's just whining that such an inferior markup system has come to dominate the 21st century. It's bad enough that we don't have our warp-drives and transporter rooms, Not even a station on the moon. 😉 You could maybe also allow other reasonably human-readable document formats. Not entirely sure AsciiDoc fits that requirement, but at least GitHub has decent support for it.
